title: Daily Gift Card Purchase Cap Across a Customer's Online Orders
content:
Gift card lines bought on Online Orders are capped per customer per day. Across all of a customer's orders placed on the same calendar day, Eastern Time, gift card lines may total at most the daily gift card purchase cap of 2000.00. A gift card line that would take the day's total above the cap is not booked. Cancelled gift card lines do not count toward the cap.

## What the day's total is

The day's total is the sum of the net amounts of the customer's booked gift card lines (e-Gift Card and plastic gift card lines) on that calendar day, Eastern Time, less the amounts of any of those lines that were cancelled. It is counted across all of the customer's orders placed that day, not order by order.

## Judgement for a new gift card line

| Day's total so far plus the new line | Result |
|---|---|
| Below 2000.00 | Line booked |
| Exactly 2000.00 | Line booked; the total does not go above the cap |
| Above 2000.00 | Line not booked |

## Running example (hypothetical lines, one customer, one calendar day in Eastern Time)

| Time | Gift card line(s) | Status | Counted toward the day | Day's total after the line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 08:15 | Two lines of 350.00 each on a first order | Booked | Yes | 700.00 |
| 09:40 | 500.00 on a second order | Booked | Yes | 1200.00 |
| 10:05 | 300.00 on a third order, later cancelled | Cancelled | No | 1200.00 |
| 12:30 | 500.00 | Booked | Yes | 1700.00 |
| 13:10 | 400.00 | Not booked; 1700.00 and 400.00 come to 2100.00, above the cap | No | 1700.00 |
| 13:20 | 300.00 | Booked; 1700.00 and 300.00 come to exactly 2000.00 | Yes | 2000.00 |

On the next calendar day, Eastern Time, the count starts again from nothing.
